gizmo.title: Umdlali wamaxwebhu
gizmo.description: Isikhokelo, umboniso nesalathiso secandelo lewebhu, namaqhosha okukopa e-HTML, import, npm ne-CDN.

configure.title: Ibhodi yebali yesikhokelo
configure.description: Ibhodi yebali yentshukumo eza nento (tag.motion.json). Ayinyanzelekanga.

configure.title: Isifundo sevidiyo
configure.description: Ividiyo emfutshane malunga nento (YouTube, Vimeo okanye ifayile yevidiyo). Ithatha indawo yevidiyo ekwidatha yamaxwebhu.

configure.title: Dlala isikhokelo ngokuzenzekelayo
configure.description: Qala isikhokelo xa nje umdlali ebonakala. Akuhoywa xa umfundi ekhetha intshukumo encitshisiweyo.

advanced.title: Isihloko sesikhokelo
advanced.description: Kwizinto ezinezikhokelo ezininzi, sesiphi isihloko esivulwa kuqala (umzekelo add-blocks). Shiya kungenanto kwesiphambili.

advanced.title: Ikhonkco lomboniso ophilayo
advanced.description: Apho iqhosha lokuvula umthombo womboniso liya khona. Ngokumiselweyo yifolda yomboniso kuvimba.

advanced.title: Ikhonkco lamaxwebhu
advanced.description: Apho iqhosha lamaxwebhu apheleleyo liya khona, umzekelo iphepha le-Learn HAX elihambelanayo.
